Sheet 560x320 inside note 560x380
nodes.rationale: Note is 560x380 total; sheet is 560x320 because of a 28px mode bar, a 28px tool strip and 4px of breathing room. Refines the spec's 560x380 sheet.

nodes.label: Atomic notes.json write
nodes.rationale: Write to a temp file then rename over the real one so a crash never leaves half a file.

nodes.label: Corrupt notes file is moved aside
nodes.rationale: A file that cannot be read as notes is renamed to notes.corrupt-<ms>.json and never silently overwritten; the app starts empty.

nodes.label: Image name by FNV-1a hash of content
nodes.rationale: FNV-1a 64 gives a stable name from the bytes; std's hasher may change between versions, and identical bytes share one file.

nodes.label: Image name validation against path traversal
nodes.rationale: The file name comes from the front-end, so only 16 lowercase hex digits plus a known extension are accepted; it must never reach outside the images folder.

nodes.label: Note storage limits
nodes.rationale: Text 20000 chars, 3000 objects per note, 2000 points per stroke, 10 images per note, 1000 notes, image up to 8 MB and 1600 px on the longest side.

nodes.label: Where a note opens: over the panel or in a window
Hidden widget forces the note into a window
nodes.rationale: A hidden widget has no panel to hang the note from, so the note gets its own window.

nodes.label: One NoteEditor hosted twice
nodes.rationale: The same NoteEditor component is hosted by the widget overlay and by the note window, so both placements behave identically.

nodes.label: Drawing logic is pure and unit tested
nodes.rationale: Geometry, history, title and filter live in src/lib as pure functions tested with vitest; components stay thin.

nodes.label: Autosave never loses the last stroke nor saves an empty note
nodes.rationale: Switching note or closing flushes the pending autosave; the backend drops empty notes.

nodes.label: Hover, blur and auto-close must not close an open note
nodes.rationale: With a note open over the panel, hover loss, focus loss, auto-close and set_widget_expanded(false) must not close it or let the mouse pass through the window.

nodes.label: Shortcuts cannot collide with each other
nodes.rationale: One shortcut must not steal another; a config without shortcut_note opens with the default.
